comment: Spike S4 (WI-0.7) seeded-contradiction corpus. Reuses the S3 story world (../s3-corpus/). Each case = upstream doc OLD revision (the s3-corpus file), a seeded edit producing the NEW revision (op=replace requires the exact substring to exist; op=append adds a line), a downstream scene written against OLD, and ground truth by construction. 8 contradiction, 12 no-contradiction, 4 ambiguous.

cases.rationale: Scene: 'until her grey eyes stung'. NEW sheet gives her brown eyes.

edit.old: - Grey eyes; dark hair kept in a sailor's braid. Left-handed.
edit.new: - Brown eyes; dark hair kept in a sailor's braid. Left-handed.

cases.rationale: Scene (present 723) twice says 'twenty-two years'; under NEW the Drowning is 28 years past.

edit.old:
- Year 701 — the Drowning of Corvel Bay: the old harbour quarter is lost
  to the sea in a single night.
edit.new:
- Year 695 — the Drowning of Corvel Bay: the old harbour quarter is lost
  to the sea in a single night.

cases.seeded_edit: raven Pitch removed (flew off two winters back)
cases.rationale: Scene has Pitch present on the gallery rail; NEW sheet says he keeps no animals since Pitch flew off.

edit.old: - Keeps a tame raven named Pitch and talks to it like an old comrade.
edit.new:
- Keeps no animals since his raven Pitch flew off two winters back; he
  still leaves the gallery rail clear out of habit.

cases.seeded_edit: iron blocks a binding -> iron strengthens a binding
cases.rationale: Scene hinges on the iron nail killing the working; NEW rule says iron steadies and strengthens it.

edit.old:
3. Cold iron blocks a binding. Iron touching the binder's skin, or placed
   between binder and target, stops the working outright.
edit.new:
3. Cold iron steadies a binding. Iron touching the binder's skin, or
   placed between binder and target, strengthens the working and doubles
   its reach.

cases.seeded_edit: branding + exile replaced by fines; branding abolished Year 715
cases.rationale: Scene (present 723): inspector threatens a hot stamp and 'second time, exile'. NEW law: fines only, no wave-mark set since 715.

edit.old:
- Unlicensed working is punished by branding on the inside of the left
  wrist — the wave-mark. A second offence means exile.

cases.rationale: Scene: 'letting the right leg have its say on every step'. NEW sheet: favours his left leg.

edit.old: he favours his right leg
edit.new: he favours his left leg

cases.rationale: Scene (present 723): 'Two years he had kept the light' and he watched the 719 fire from a troop ship. NEW: post since 716 (seven years, and he'd have been keeping the light in 719).

edit.old: - Year 721 — Marcus Hale takes the Gullpoint lighthouse post.
edit.new: - Year 716 — Marcus Hale takes the Gullpoint lighthouse post.

cases.seeded_edit: price of a working: sleep -> memories
cases.rationale: Scene is built on the sleep-debt collecting the following night; NEW rule prices workings in fading memories, by morning.

edit.old:
2. Every working is paid for in sleep: hours of dreamless sleep in
   proportion to the working's size, collected the following night whether
   the binder wills it or not.
edit.new:
2. Every working is paid for in memory: small recollections fade in
   proportion to the working's size, gone by the following morning whether
   the binder wills it or not.

cases.rationale: Pure rewording: same compass, same worn lid.

edit.old:
- Carries her late mother's brass compass everywhere; its lid is worn
  smooth by her thumb.
edit.new:
- Her dead mother's brass compass never leaves her pocket; years of her
  thumb have polished the lid smooth.

cases.rationale: Additive detail the scene never touches.

edit.new: - Sweet tooth: candied plums when she can afford them, which is rarely.

cases.rationale: Same campaign, same retirement, different words.

edit.old: - Late fifties. A retired soldier of the Ashfleet campaign.
edit.new:
- In his late fifties; he soldiered through the Ashfleet campaign before
  they pensioned him off.

cases.rationale: Additive detail; the scene's silence while working is not a denial of humming elsewhere — nothing in the scene depends on it.

edit.new: - Hums old marching songs while trimming the wick, badly.

cases.rationale: Scene has a single binder; the new rule is never engaged.

edit.new:
6. Two binders cannot work the same target at once; the two workings
   cancel each other.

cases.rationale: Same smell, same audience, same duration — different sentence shape.

edit.old:
4. A completed working leaves a distinct smell of ozone and hot salt,
   noticeable to anyone nearby for a few minutes.
edit.new:
4. For a few minutes after a working completes, anyone nearby can smell
   it: ozone and hot salt, unmistakable.

cases.rationale: Funding detail the scene never touches.

edit.new: - Inspectors are salaried from the harbour tax.

cases.rationale: New event between existing ones; the scene's arithmetic is untouched.

edit.old: - Year 718 — the Long Fog descends in autumn.
edit.new:
- Year 715 — the twin comets stand over the bay for a month.
- Year 718 — the Long Fog descends in autumn.

cases.seeded_edit: Ashfleet fire entry reworded, same year (adds 'forty hulls lost')
cases.rationale: Same year, richer wording; the scene's forty paper ships remain consistent.

edit.old:
- Year 719 — the Long Fog lifts in spring. That summer, the Ashfleet
  burns at anchor.
edit.new:
- Year 719 — the Long Fog lifts in spring. That summer, fire takes the
  Ashfleet at anchor; forty hulls lost.

cases.seeded_edit: apprentice curfew ninth bell -> tenth bell
cases.rationale: A real semantic change, but the scene never touches the curfew.

edit.old: - Guild apprentices are under curfew from the ninth bell.
edit.new: - Guild apprentices are under curfew from the tenth bell.

cases.seeded_edit: fear of deep water given an origin (ferry capsize at six)
cases.rationale: Adds an origin story to the same fear; scene states the fear without an origin.

edit.old: - Afraid of deep water since childhood; never learned to swim.
edit.new:
- Afraid of deep water since the ferry capsize when she was six; never
  learned to swim.

cases.rationale: A style-guide drift is divergence, not a factual contradiction; the checker should not report contradiction.

edit.old: - Prefer sentences under twenty-five words; vary the rhythm.
edit.new: - Prefer sentences under fifteen words; vary the rhythm.

cases.seeded_edit: branding abolished Year 722; existing marks remain; exile retained
cases.rationale: Arguable both ways: her old mark (set before 722) and second-offence exile stay consistent, but the scene frames the inspector as a present threat to 'a wrist', which no longer holds under NEW.

edit.old:
- Unlicensed working is punished by branding on the inside of the left
  wrist — the wave-mark. A second offence means exile.
edit.new:
- Branding was abolished by decree in Year 722; wave-marks already set
  remain on the Guild register. Unlicensed working is punished by seizure
  of goods; a second offence still means exile.

cases.seeded_edit: distrusts the Guild, loud about it -> lately an uneasy peace
cases.rationale: Arguable: a man at an uneasy peace can still say he has no love for the Guild — or the scene's vocal hostility contradicts the truce.

edit.old: - Distrusts the Lantern Guild and is loud about it.
edit.new:
- Has lately come to an uneasy peace with the Lantern Guild, though he
  will not say why.

cases.seeded_edit: slow to anger / patient bargainer -> quick-tempered; patience costs visible effort
cases.rationale: Arguable: the scene shows effortless, habitual patience at the market ('the pause did her haggling for her'), which sits badly with patience costing visible effort — but one calm scene does not prove a temperament.

edit.old:
- Temperament: slow to anger, a patient bargainer; goes quiet when hurt.
  Dry humour, precise speech.
edit.new:
- Temperament: quick-tempered since the Ashfleet year; patience costs her
  visible effort. Goes quiet when hurt. Dry humour, precise speech.

cases.seeded_edit: working smell noticeable to anyone -> detectable only by other tidebinders
cases.rationale: Arguable: the baker's boy wrinkling his nose reads as a non-binder smelling the working — but the scene only says 'she supposed', and the boy could have reacted to anything (or be a binder, one in four hundred).

edit.old:
4. A completed working leaves a distinct smell of ozone and hot salt,
   noticeable to anyone nearby for a few minutes.
edit.new:
4. A completed working leaves a faint smell of ozone and hot salt that
   only other tidebinders can detect.
